## The triangle inequality {#fv1-triangle .fv-lesson }

```{=html}
<div class="fv-equation"><span data-math="\displaystyle \bigl||\underset{\sim}{a}|-|\underset{\sim}{b}|\bigr|\leq|\underset{\sim}{a}+\underset{\sim}{b}|\leq|\underset{\sim}{a}|+|\underset{\sim}{b}|"></span></div><div class="fv-triangle-layout"><div class="fv-triangle-diagram" role="img" aria-label="Two vectors placed head to tail form a triangle; their sum is the direct displacement."></div><div><p>The direct distance cannot exceed the total distance along the two vectors.</p><p class="small">For non-zero vectors:<br><strong>Same direction:</strong> upper bound.<br><strong>Opposite directions:</strong> lower bound.</p></div></div>
```

<div class="booklet-cue">Booklet §1.3 · p. 9</div>

::: {.notes}
Brief explanation only: no routine, slider, response activity or timer. Read the two bounds and relate the upper bound to the static head-to-tail diagram. Equality at the upper bound occurs for vectors in the same direction; equality at the lower bound occurs for opposite directions. If either vector is zero, both bounds are attained.
:::
